2608.23992.title: Hybrid Semantic Tool Discovery for Enterprise MCP Gateway: Architecture and Implementation
2608.23992.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents invoke external tools to retrieve and reason over information beyond pretrained knowledge. The Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes how such tools are surfaced, and a proxy MCP server aggregates many backend servers behind a single endpoint providing a secure, governable chokepoint for authentication, policy enforcement, and observability. This architecture creates two compounding challenges: a context-engineering bottleneck where full tool schemas saturate the model context window before any user query, and a tool discoverability barrier where users and agents cannot identify the best tool among 2,000+ indexed tools across 200+ MCP servers. Prompt caching reduces reprocessing cost but neither frees context capacity nor improves accuracy. We present SCOUT (Selective Context Optimization for Universal Tooling), which reframes tool exposure as a context-selection problem, injecting only tools relevant to the current step. SCOUT surfaces two MCP meta-tools -- tool_search and execute_tool -- where tool_search performs hybrid retrieval, fusing BM25 sparse matching with dense vector search via Reciprocal Rank Fusion to return the top-k relevant tools. Backed by zero-downtime catalog update pipelines, SCOUT resolves both context saturation and tool discovery challenges. In production at PayPal, SCOUT reduces MCP tool-token consumption from 140.2k tokens (70.1% of context) to 1.3k tokens (0.8%), a 99% reduction, cutting per-query inference cost at enterprise scale. Because SCOUT is surfaced as standard MCP tools, it is model-agnostic and requires no client-side modifications.
2608.23992.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型 (LLM) 代理人調用外部工具以檢索和推理超出預訓練知識的信息。模型上下文協議 (MCP) 標準化了如何顯示這些工具，而代理 MCP 伺服器在單一端點後聚合多個後端伺服器，提供一個安全、可管理的關鍵點，用於身份驗證、政策執行和可觀察性。這種架構帶來了兩個複合挑戰：一個是上下文工程瓶頸，在任何用戶查詢之前，完整的工具架構就已經飽和了模型上下文窗口；另一個是工具可發現性障礙，用戶和代理無法在 200 多個 MCP 伺服器中識別 2000 多個索引工具中最合適的工具。提示緩存減少了重新處理的成本，但既無法釋放上下文容量，也無法提高準確性。我們提出了 SCOUT（通用工具的選擇性上下文優化），將工具曝光重新構建為上下文選擇問題，只注入與當前步驟相關的工具。SCOUT 顯示了兩個 MCP 元工具——tool_search 和 execute_tool——其中 tool_search 執行混合檢索，通過互惠排名融合將 BM25 稀疏匹配與密集向量搜索結合，以返回前 k 個相關工具。在零停機時間的目錄更新管道的支持下，SCOUT 解決了上下文飽和和工具發現的挑戰。在 PayPal 的生產環境中，SCOUT 將 MCP 工具令牌消耗從 140.2k 令牌（佔上下文的 70.1%）減少到 1.3k 令牌（0.8%），減少了 99%，在企業規模上降低了每次查詢的推理成本。由於 SCOUT 被顯示為標準 MCP 工具，因此它是模型無關的，並且不需要客戶端的修改。
